entities.summary: Stratonice of Pontus was a Greek woman from the Kingdom of Pontus who played a pivotal role in shaping the politics of the ancient Mediterranean. Born into a noble family, she rose to prominence as a member of the royal court of King Mithridates VI of Pontus, one of the most powerful men in the region. Stratonice's influence extended beyond Pontus, as she formed alliances with other Hellenistic kingdoms and even married a Roman senator, further solidifying her position as a key player in the complex web of international relations. Despite her significant impact, Stratonice's legacy has been largely overshadowed by that of her more famous contemporaries, leaving behind a fascinating and complex portrait of a woman who defied convention and navigated the treacherous waters of ancient politics with remarkable skill and intelligence.
